formula: k*=min(k,N-k); c=2*k*/N; b=min(255,floor(256*c)); B_train={b(k_i):i in train}; R(k)=1 iff b(k) in B_train; 8-bit LOCKED; no r,s,z features
holdout_split: train n<=50; test n>50; LOSO by source
trivial_exclusion_justification: Uses only historical k* magnitude bins; not P=[d]G or curve equation.
